races.paceDynamic: Mullacash Buzz will lead uncontested from the start, with no other genuine pace horses committed to going forward early. Brains, Manhattan Dandy, Serengeti Sunrise, My Kurkum, Your Out Of Line and Areyousure will sit prominent but are unlikely to pressure the leader through the early stages. This sets up a steady gallop that will build gradually, with the real racing happening from 3f out when the hold-up horses like Jasmine Affanalis, Kitty Bear, Cordouan and Profit Surge make their moves. The tactical verdict is clear: this moderate pace strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, as they'll get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mullacash Buzz sets an uncontested lead through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as the finishers sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Hold-up specialists get the ideal scenario with plenty left in the tank for their trademark late flourishes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses increase pressure from 4f out and sustain their effort
scenarios.body: The mid-division runners avoid the sprint finish by grinding out the leaders before the hold-up horses can get into top gear. Those who tracked the pace without going too hard early prove best positioned.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mullacash Buzz Hangs On
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains a strong gallop and the chasers leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The front-runner's uncontested lead proves decisive as he finds enough in the tank to repel late challenges. His 18-day break and dropping class gives him the edge when others close.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Mullacash Buzz stops quickly and the prominent horses fail to capitalize
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with no genuine pace, creating a sprint finish that suits the least expected profile. A horse that normally needs stronger pace benefits from the change of tactics.

races.paceDynamic: Fast Tara will lead from the gates with no other confirmed front-runners, creating a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The prominent group of Sun Soldier, Shoot To Kill, Chester Nimitz, Neo Smart, Gloriously Glam and Minaun View will track the leader in a sizeable pack, while the large hold-up contingent including San Aer, Anvika, Earls, Highbury See See, Finsceal Annie, Altimara, Zaraahmando, Spent All Me Money and Navagio will be positioned towards the rear. With only one natural leader and 18 runners, the pace will be controlled early before quickening significantly from the 3f pole as the field compresses. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong gallop and have room to manoeuvre in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Tara sets sustainable fractions and the field stays bunched until the straight
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows closers to stay in touch before unleashing finishing kicks, with the large field creating traffic problems for prominent runners. Hold-up specialists get clear runs and overwhelm the pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack applies more pressure to Fast Tara from halfway and quickens the tempo
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and puts hold-up horses under pressure to stay in contention. Well-positioned prominent runners get first run on the leaders and maintain their advantage to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fast Tara Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Tara gets soft sectionals and the field allows her too much rope through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field struggles to close the gap despite a strong finish. Her stamina reserves prove decisive when challenged in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Tara goes too slow and the prominent runners fail to commit until very late
scenarios.body: The crawling pace becomes a sprint finish where the best turn-of-foot prevails regardless of position. Horses with high cruising speed can overcome poor positions through pure acceleration.

races.paceDynamic: Girl Bear looks the sole committed early leader with Gold Inn, Coincidental Glory and Merry Blacksmith likely to race prominently behind her. With such a large field of hold-up horses including Personified, Thirsty Owl, Zermatt Star and others, Girl Bear should get an easy lead and controlled fractions through the early stages. The pace will quicken from halfway as the prominent racers try to kick clear before the cavalry charge arrives from the rear. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration, as they'll get the perfect scenario of a steady pace followed by a strong gallop to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Girl Bear sets steady fractions and the prominent runners fail to quicken decisively
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses will have perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Class horses like Personified and Thirsty Owl can exploit their superior turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Gold Inn or Coincidental Glory can sustain pressure on Girl Bear from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: They can string out the field and make it harder for the hold-up brigade to close the gap. Coincidental Glory's recent form suggests he has the tactical speed to exploit this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Girl Bear goes too slow early and everyone arrives together in a bunch finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 2f pole where any horse with a turn of foot can win. This levels the playing field significantly between all running styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Girl Bear Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Girl Bear faces no meaningful pressure and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: She can exploit the passive tactics behind her to steal a march on the field. However, her recent form suggests she may struggle to sustain the effort.

races.paceDynamic: Rebel Ascendant will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with no obvious pace pressure from this field of predominantly hold-up horses. Sir Benji, Dial Me In, Nil Bua Gan Dua and Marjorie Daw all prefer to come from off the pace, while Elzaam Express remains an unknown quantity. The lack of early pace will create a tactical affair with positioning crucial heading into the straight. This race shape clearly favours horses with enough early pace to get into striking position early, as the lack of genuine speed will make it difficult for pure hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Ascendant gets soft sectionals on the front end
scenarios.body: The prominent runner will have too much left in the tank for the hold-up brigade to peg back. His recent win suggests he can sustain a gallop when allowed to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The higher-rated hold-up horses can showcase their class in a dash to the line. Nil Bua Gan Dua and Sir Benji have shown good finishing kicks previously.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mystery Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Elzaam Express shows unexpectedly sharp early pace from the Cromwell yard
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced runner could have the tactical advantage of getting into an ideal position behind Rebel Ascendant. His high rating suggests significant ability if ready to do himself justice.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If positioning becomes crucial in a slowly-run affair with a messy finish
scenarios.body: Dial Me In's recent form suggests he can adapt tactically and his trainer's strike rate provides confidence. The race could become scrappy with traffic problems for the pure hold-up horses.

The prominent runners Churchwarden, Daboya, Parish Express and Makaiah will settle just behind but none are aggressive early types. This creates a tactical race where the pace will be moderate to steady, allowing hold-up horses to stay in touch throughout. The sustainable gallop and large field size strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can produce late kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Radar Ahead leading comfortably
scenarios.body: The 12 hold-up horses get perfect conditions to stay in touch and unleash finishing kicks in the straight. Late runners with class like Stepdance, Forlio and Master Sydney can pick off the early leaders who've had an easy time of it.

scenarios.trigger: If Radar Ahead goes too slow and multiple horses make moves simultaneously

races.paceDynamic: Marazion will lead from the gates with Harana and Massarat likely to press forward, creating a modest early gallop over this stamina-testing trip. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, with most of the field content to settle behind the leaders in the opening stages. Carmel's Phoenix, Guy's Girl, and several other hold-up performers will look to build momentum from the back as the race develops. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and control their own destiny over the extended distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Marazion and Harana maintain a steady tempo without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The leaders get an uncontested run to the home turn before the closers can mount their challenge. Front-runners with stamina reserves prove too tough to peg back over this demanding trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks in a sprint finish. Quality closers with tactical speed can exploit the compressed field and slow tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent racers press Marazion and create genuine pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The increased gallop plays into the hands of horses with proven stamina who can sustain their effort. The race becomes a test of durability rather than a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites disappoint or encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: Longshots benefit from the chaos as superior horses fail to deliver their expected performances. Lesser-fancied runners with nothing to lose can capitalise on the open race.

watchPoints.text: Marazion must handle the 201-day layoff as her pace-setting role becomes crucial if she lacks full fitness
Harana carries stable confidence despite the lengthy absence but Weld's runners often need their first run back
Carmel's Phoenix needs clear passage from her hold-up position as traffic could prove decisive in a large field
Several hold-up horses including Duvessa and Enchanted Lady have shown tendencies to fade in the finish
The pace early will determine whether this becomes a test of stamina or develops into a tactical sprint finish
